challenges.finding: Publisher reports insecurity and persistent threats against response teams in Tshopo (Bafwasende, Kabondo and Mangobo); the Butuhe PoC (Nord-Kivu) still closed since a September security incident; some PoC transfers of febrile travellers in Ituri delayed for lack of ambulances; 4 bodies intercepted at Tshopo PoCs, 3 of them carried by motorcycle without control measures on the Banalia axis; one body conveyed from Bujumbura to Goma through Uvira (Kavimvira) on 10 November after a death on 5 November as printed, with no test result or case status stated; community resistance overcome around a suspect case in Haut-Uele; and in Bas-Uele a calm situation but no guard shelters at secured sites, too little transport and no diesel in stock. The Butuhe closure (SR178, SR179) and the Tshopo threats at Bafwasende, Kabondo and Mangobo (SR173) were printed before. No intervention effect is established.

Contact follow-up covers six reporting provinces. The 267-contact cohort printed under Nord-Ubangi has its province attribution withheld, and the Sud-Ubangi row repeats SR171-SR175 values and is withheld. The lowest printed rate is Nord-Kivu (79.1%). No zero follow-up is inferred for any province.
